hypothesis: The NYMEX maintenance pause is a daily information boundary. The first completed fifteen-minute CL auction after reopen may show whether the shared CL/MCL gap was accepted or rejected; dominant CL discovers direction and matched MCL must confirm the same prior-close verdict before any executable projection.

frozen_auction.reference: last completed five-minute CL/MCL close before the daily NYMEX maintenance boundary
frozen_auction.gap: first post-maintenance CL and MCL opens must share one nonzero direction relative to their own prior closes
frozen_auction.verdict: after exactly the first three completed five-minute bars, both CL and MCL closes must remain on the gap side for acceptance or cross the opposite side for failure
frozen_auction.direction: follow the shared gap after acceptance; fade the shared gap after failure
frozen_auction.frequency: maximum one event per Globex session
frozen_auction.weekend: included and explicitly attributed; contract-roll sessions excluded

frozen_order: reconstruct completed five-minute session boundaries on the exact dated CL/MCL tape
exclude contract-roll boundaries and incomplete first-fifteen-minute auctions
require shared nonzero CL/MCL reopen-gap direction
classify exactly one completed fifteen-minute acceptance or failure verdict
count discovery and validation independently before any forward return
if_eligible: Preregister exactly one branch-aware lifecycle with next-open MCL entry, semantic prior-close/gap invalidation and hard session/contract/gap flat; discovery must pass before validation opens. News may later annotate weekend shock but has no authority.
prohibitions: no gap magnitude, ATR normalization, alternate 5/10/20/30-minute verdict, partial bar, volume, flow, VWAP, Europe/US anchor, retained-state gate, news, stop distance, target, timeout, cooldown, replacement event, or quota
no trade outcome, MFE, MAE, PnL, validation economics, order, capital, XSP, or Gold authority
downstream_hold_even_on_pass: missing July 2023 through August 2024 dated-contract history
unseen runtime parity and prospective signal tape
native MCL spread, liquidity, margin, commission, roll, preview, restart, reconciliation, shared-capital, and graduation proof
